_comment: Administrative rollup + scope hierarchy for the 2023 Turkiye-Syria earthquake.
Written 2026-08-10 in response to a HELD-OUT failure, not in advance. The scope gate
(EKF_MHT_DESIGN sec 25) works on Helene and could not run here at all, because it judges a
part against a declared whole and this event had neither: turkey and syria are siblings
with no parent, and the combined toll never got its own stream. Generalizing the gate to
use a global maximum instead made it circular -- Turkey is 87.6% of its own total, so
Turkey was judged against a reference Turkey itself defines, and its TRUE value of 1,014
at t=12.5h was rerouted as if it were an aggregate.
`hierarchy` fixes the declaration. `aliases` is what has to fix the DATA: the joint-scope
phrasing this feed actually uses is 'Syria and Turkey' (verified present; the reverse order
is not), and until such figures are keyed __aggregate__ there are no aggregate observations
for a part to be judged against. Note the province entries are deliberately sparse -- hatay
and adana are the only sub-national places the pipeline has ever emitted here, so the rest
Unlike Helene this event does NOT set collapse_type: every observation here is already the
one event type (Earthquakes), so collapsing buys nothing and would only make the two
datasets' keys differ for no reason.
